Carrier checks for pet travel

Before you head to the airport, give the carrier a careful look. A solid carrier helps keep your animal calm, secure, and protected while staff handle the trip. The Companion Animal Travel Desk helps travelers prepare carriers with the same patient care we give every traveling pet.

Check that the carrier is clean, dry, and free from sharp edges. Make sure the door closes firmly and the latches stay shut when nudged. If the carrier flexes too much, rattles, or smells strong from old bedding or cleaners, it is better to fix that before the trip.

Inside the carrier, use soft bedding that will not bunch up or slip around. Leave enough room for your pet to lie down and turn comfortably, and keep loose items out unless the staff says they are safe. If your pet is new to travel, let it spend a little quiet time near the carrier at home so the space feels familiar.

Aurelia Skyways staff may inspect the carrier at the desk, so keep it easy to open and close. <<FACT F068>> If you are traveling with a pet like Penny, bring any required travel papers and follow the guidance from the desk team.

Watch your pet's comfort as you prepare. Short pauses, calm handling, and gentle voice cues can make a big difference. If anything looks worn, broken, or unsafe, replace it before travel day.

For more help, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk for friendly guidance before you fly.
